svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 06/12 The Islands (Uncommon)
svg.desc: On a clear day the Channel Islands sit on the horizon like they were painted there. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
